definitions.explanation: Doing something with conscious intention rather than by accident.

examples.japanese: わざと⟦やった→やる：02980_yaru⟧んです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Did you do it on purpose?

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧わざと⟦{無視|むし}した→無視：13473_mushi⟧。
わざと⟦{間違|まちが}えた→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦わけ→訳：01095_wake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I didn't make the mistake on purpose.
examples.notes: Often used in negative sentences to deny intentionality

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧わざと⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: He deliberately raised his voice to get everyone's attention.

examples.japanese: わざと⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦のか→の：09472_no⟧、⟦それとも→それとも：03324_soretomo⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦のか→の：09472_no⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦わからなかった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Nobody could tell whether he lost on purpose or truly lost.

notes:
USAGE: わざと emphasizes that an action was done intentionally, often with a slightly negative nuance suggesting the action was improper or meant to cause trouble.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- わざと - on purpose (often negative nuance)
- ⟦{意図的|いとてき}→意図的：16841_itoteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - intentionally (neutral, formal)
- ⟦{故意|こい}→故意：16844_koi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - deliberately (legal/formal, negative)
- ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧ - carelessly, accidentally (opposite)

POSITION: Usually placed before the verb it modifies.
